profile.description: Omani Qatari Telecommunications Company SAOG engages in the development, operation, and maintenance of mobile and fixed telecommunications services in the Sultanate of Oman. The company offers mobile telecommunication services; and installation, operation, maintenance, and exploitation of fixed public telecommunications systems. It is also involved in the data collection, management, and operation of data preparation of other agencies; and activities, such as wired telecommunications, maintenance of networks, and renting of communication equipment. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Muscat, the Sultanate of Oman. Omani Qatari Telecommunications Company SAOG operates as a subsidiary of Seyoula International Investment W.L.L.
